items.title: Ampleness of an invertible sheaf passes up and down along a finite surjective morphism of algebraic spaces proper over a Noetherian ring

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for a finite surjective morphism of algebraic spaces proper over a Noetherian ring, ampleness of an invertible sheaf is equivalent to ampleness of its pullback, together with the scheme-theoretic nature of the source (statement lines 4133-4143). One implication is immediate from representability of finite morphisms and the scheme case; for the other the proof sets up the cohomological vanishing property, feeds it through the criterion for properties of coherent sheaves on a Noetherian space, and in the remaining condition analyses the behaviour of an ideal on an irreducible support through an auxiliary finite cover and a chain of equalities using the projection formula and Leray. The verification of condition (3) is the substance, so the claim is H2.
